exact_cover_quotes.quote: A supervisor that finds that tmux server when it starts ends it, and with it everything that still ran in an old terminal, without needing a tmux program. A session whose agent was still launching, running or being stopped in one becomes interrupted, as after a reboot, and gets the notice Status describes; one whose agent had already ended keeps its outcome, but its terminal's last screen, which lived in the server, is gone; old tabs are closed.

A failure to end the server or to stop what ran there is logged and never stops the supervisor from starting; those sessions are treated as ended all the same, accepting that a Restart could then start a second agent beside one still running.

exact_cover_quotes.quote: A failure anywhere is logged and never fatal (the maintainer chose to start anyway and treat old sessions as ended, accepting that a Restart could then start a second agent beside one still running)
